name: finalize-site
description: Use for the finalize site stage of building or repairing a website from a GitHub repository.
---

# Finalize Site

Inspect diff, validate, scan secrets/placeholders, check routes/assets/mobile/accessibility/SEO, update docs and append log. Set COMPLETE only when repository-controlled gates pass.

Read the repository assessment and current site manifest. Record evidence and changes in docs/site-builder/work-log.md. Continue to the next stage unless an actual external authorization boundary remains.
